market_outlook.short_term: Choppy and risk-off. Oil spike from US-Iran attacks and shipping fuel shortage create inflationary pressure. Bond yields climbing toward 5%+ threshold. Rare market warning signal suggests 10-15% equity drawdown risk within 60-90 days. Yen intervention adds FX volatility. AI rotation provides sector-level support but cannot offset macro headwinds. Expect elevated VIX (25-35 range).
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but conditional. AI capex cycle broadening (CPU, networking, data centers) supports tech earnings through 2027. Gulf sovereign wealth funding infrastructure. EM tech outperformance continues. However, 5.5% yield scenario would force multiple compression. Energy transition (LNG, dual-fuel) creates structural winners. Key variable: Fed path and whether rate hikes materialize.
